/.title: Wedding & Luxury Cakes in the UAE
/.description: Browse Maison Zavi wedding, luxury and engagement cakes. Choose tiered, fresh floral or sugar flower designs and request a quote for UAE delivery.

/collections.title: Wedding & Celebration Cake Collections
/collections.description: Explore six Maison Zavi collections: wedding, luxury, engagement, tiered, fresh floral and sugar flower cakes. Compare designs and request a quote.

/collections/all.title: Wedding, Luxury & Engagement Cake Designs
/collections/all.description: Browse all Maison Zavi cake designs. Filter by occasion, tiers, flowers, flavour and price, then select a cake and request a quote for your event.

/collections/wedding-cakes.title: Wedding Cakes in Dubai & the UAE
/collections/wedding-cakes.description: Browse tiered wedding cakes with fresh flowers, sugar flowers and piped decoration. Choose a design and request a quote from Maison Zavi for UAE delivery.

/collections/luxury-cakes.title: Luxury Cakes with Sculpted & Floral Designs
/collections/luxury-cakes.description: Explore Maison Zavi luxury cakes with tall tiers, sculpted decorations and metallic finishes. Request a quote with your event date and guest count.

/collections/engagement-cakes.title: Engagement & Proposal Cakes
/collections/engagement-cakes.description: Discover engagement and proposal cakes with flowers, ring decorations and engagement toppers. Choose your options and request a quote from Maison Zavi.

/collections/tiered-cakes.title: Tiered Wedding & Celebration Cakes
/collections/tiered-cakes.description: Browse cakes with two or more tiers. Choose sponge and filling options by tier, then confirm size and delivery in your Maison Zavi cake quote.

/collections/fresh-floral-cakes.title: Fresh Flower Cakes with Roses, Peonies & Dahlias
/collections/fresh-floral-cakes.description: Browse fresh flower cakes with roses, peonies, dahlias and mixed arrangements. Choose flower combinations and request a cake quote from Maison Zavi.

/collections/sugar-flower-cakes.title: Sugar Flower Cakes with Roses & Peonies
/collections/sugar-flower-cakes.description: Explore cakes decorated with sugar roses, peonies, magnolias and floral cascades. Request a quote from Maison Zavi with your preferred size and colours.

/atelier.title: Our Story: Born in Dubai
/atelier.description: Meet Maison Zavi, born in the heart of Dubai. Discover our approach to personal wedding, engagement and celebration cakes, from flowers and colours to flavours.

/bespoke.title: Request a Custom Cake Quote
/bespoke.description: Request a custom wedding, engagement or celebration cake from Maison Zavi. Share your date, guest count, budget and design ideas, with optional reference photos.

/contact.title: Contact Maison Zavi
/contact.description: Message Maison Zavi on WhatsApp at +971 54 597 4005 for cake enquiries, custom designs and order discussions, or send your details through our contact form.

/delivery.title: Cake Delivery in Dubai & Across the UAE
/delivery.description: Maison Zavi cake delivery costs AED 100 in Dubai and AED 200 in other emirates. Read delivery, date confirmation and collection arrangements before ordering.

/faq.title: Cake Ordering & Delivery FAQs
/faq.description: Find answers about choosing a cake, custom designs, order confirmation, payment arrangements, UAE delivery and dietary requests at Maison Zavi.

/privacy.title: Privacy Policy
/privacy.description: Read how Maison Zavi handles contact details, cake enquiries, reference photos, saved selections and order information, and how to ask about your data.

/policies/refund-policy.title: Cake Refunds & Cancellations Policy
/policies/refund-policy.description: Read Maison Zavi terms for cake cancellations, changes, refunds and reporting an issue with an order. Contact us with your order reference for assistance.

/policies/terms-of-service.title: Cake Orders: Terms & Conditions
/policies/terms-of-service.description: Read Maison Zavi terms and conditions for using the website, requesting cakes and confirming orders, including prices, payment and delivery arrangements.

/policies/substitution-policy.title: Cake Decoration Substitution Policy
/policies/substitution-policy.description: Read Maison Zavi guidance on substitutions for cake flowers, colours and decorations, including how design changes are discussed before your order.

/policies/edible-items-policy.title: Cake Ingredients, Allergens & Care
/policies/edible-items-policy.description: Read Maison Zavi guidance on cake ingredients, allergens, edible and non-edible decorations, food colouring, storage, handling and serving.

/search.title: Search Cake Designs
/search.description: Search Maison Zavi cakes by colour, flowers or style. Filter matching designs by tiers, flavour and price.

/wishlist.title: Your Saved Cake Designs
/wishlist.description: Review the Maison Zavi cake designs saved in this browser. Open a cake to choose options or add it to your quote.

/cart.title: Your Cake Quote
/cart.description: Review your selected cakes, flavours and quantities before sending a Maison Zavi order request. Prices and availability are confirmed before ordering.

/bag.title: Your Cake Selection
/bag.description: Review the cakes in your Maison Zavi bag and update quantities before preparing your order request.

/checkout.title: Send Your Cake Order Request
/checkout.description: Add your contact details, event date and delivery address to your Maison Zavi cake request. Orders and payment arrangements are confirmed separately.

/404.title: Page Not Found
/404.description: This Maison Zavi page could not be found. Browse our cake collections or contact us for help finding a design.
